caption:
An alert that cannot survive cross-examination is worthless to the person who has to act on it. That is the standard we build to — not persuasion, evidence.

Every output carries its own confidence grade and its own gaps. We state what the system saw, what it inferred, and what it did not observe. If a finding cannot be traced back to the imagery and the method that produced it, it does not go out as a finding.

The September 2022 Numan flood hindcast is the one case we point to publicly: the reach-monitoring array flagged the signature four days ahead of the official warning, and the 2021 control year stayed quiet when nothing was there. One confirmed result, honestly scoped, beats a sales deck full of assertions.

A commander does not need confidence. A commander needs to know exactly how much to trust the line in front of him.
